Lufthansa Group and Portuguese Government Sign Agreement for Acquisition of a Minority Stake in TAP Air Portugal

The Lufthansa Group and the Portuguese government signed the agreement for the acquisition of an initial minority stake of 44.9 percent in TAP Air Portugal at Humberto Delgado Airport in Lisbon on November 3, 2026. This marks a decisive milestone in the privatization process of TAP. Completion of the acquisition remains subject to approval by the relevant authorities, in particular the European Commission.
